# TutorLoft

TutorLoft is an open-source, single-tutor workspace for scheduling, course materials, assignments, auto-graded quizzes, gradebook feedback, progress reports, parent visibility, and TL-prefixed invoice tracking.

Website: https://tutorloft-workspace.vercel.app/
Read-only demo: https://tutorloft-workspace.vercel.app/demo
Repository: https://github.com/tanzir71/tutorloft

## Public demo

The public /demo route uses static seeded data and role switches for Tutor, Student, and Parent. It is read-only, resets on reload, makes no database mutations, sends no email, uploads no files, processes no payments, and calls no AI provider.

## Local setup

npm install
copy .env.example .env.local
npm run db:migrate
npm run seed
npm run dev

Required: Node.js, DATABASE_URL, AUTH_SECRET, TUTOR_EMAIL, and TUTOR_PASSWORD. A local SQLite file works for development.

## Vercel setup

1. Create a Turso/libSQL database.
2. Set DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN, AUTH_SECRET, TUTOR_EMAIL, TUTOR_PASSWORD, and CRON_SECRET in Vercel.
3. Run npm run db:migrate against production.
4. Run npm run seed once against production.
5. Deploy the Next.js app.

RESEND_API_KEY enables email. BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN enables Vercel Blob uploads. Both are optional. AI settings are configured by the tutor inside the app and are not required for core workflows.

## Product boundaries

- One tutor owner per deployment by design.
- Students see their own learning records; parent accounts have scoped family visibility.
- Invoices and payment status are tracked; TutorLoft does not process payments.
- The deployer owns database credentials, migrations, exports, and backups.
- Vercel Hobby and Turso free tiers can make a small instance approximately $0/month, subject to current provider limits.
